units.source_text: 浦岛太郎是古代传说中的人物。

en.t: Urashima Taro is a figure from ancient legend.

units.source_text: 此人是一渔夫，与龟共赴龙宫，居住三年，享尽荣华。

en.t: He was a fisherman who went with a turtle to the Dragon Palace, lived there for three years, and enjoyed every luxury.

units.source_text: 临别一美女赠他玉盒一具，诫不可开。

en.t: When they parted, a beautiful woman gave him a jeweled box and warned him not to open it.

units.source_text: 此人归家后破戒开盒，与盒中喷出之白烟共化为老翁。

en.t: After returning home, he broke the warning and opened the box, and together with the white smoke that poured out of it, he turned into an old man.
